data.name: Wild Shape
data.description: An undine adept gains the ability to use wild shape. When an undine takes the form of a creature with the aquatic or water subtype, this ability functions at level %1. For all other forms, her effective druid level for the ability is equal to her actual undine adept level.|DruidLVL+1
